name: Lighthouse Marina
brand_truth: Since 1980, the fuel dock and boatyard at the foot of the Elbow Reef Lighthouse, the one stop every Elbow Cay boat makes.
buyer: Hope Town boaters (owners and renters of 20-40 ft centre consoles, cruisers to 60 ft) needing fuel, a slip, a mechanic or seasonal dry storage; Elbow Cay second-home owners.

design.signature: SVG Elbow Reef Lighthouse with sweeping beam; 'Will your boat fit?' check against 60 ft LOA / 6 ft draft; haul-out and storage estimator on Nov 2024 boatyard rates with VAT; tabbed slip/yard/mechanic enquiry

current_site_findings: Footer (c) 2023, Gmail contact, default Wix favicon and 'Home | LighthouseMarina' title
No slip/dockage rates; the Dockage button goes to boatyard rates
DIY yard rate $50/day on rates page, $40/day on facilities page
Liquor store 'reopening soon' vs listed in menu
Blurred homepage thumbnails; key facts not in Google snippet
pitch_line: You run the only marine fuel on Elbow Cay at the foot of the lighthouse, but Google shows 'Home | LighthouseMarina'; this concept puts your 60-ft, 6-ft-draft slips, fuel and boatyard prices in the first screen and lets boaters price a haul-out themselves.
assumptions: DIY rate shown as $50/day (rates page, effective Nov 2024)
Liquor (cold beer, wines, spirits, cigars) listed as in store per homepage header; confirm reopening
Lighthouse drawn red and white (Elbow Reef Lighthouse's real livery); the marina's own site only says 'historic'
Rental cottages shown as under long-term rental (their page)
notes: Slip rates are not published; site asks boaters to contact the office. Interact 'dead inputs' are range sliders/checkbox Playwright can't fill; they work. Lighthouse red used only inside the illustration, not as a UI accent. Scorecard: hero 4, type 4, layout 4, context 5, motion 4, depth 4, detailing 4, mobile 4, refs 4, pride 4, consistency 4.
